---
title: "Mechanisms: why attending an over-demanded school lowers graduation and college assignment"
params:
  data_dir: !r file.path(ifelse(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE") != "", Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), path.expand("~")), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data", "finalized_design_v1", "mechanisms")
  out_dir: "output"
---

This notebook writes every table file of the paper's mechanisms section and of its appendix into `out_dir/tables/`, in the layout of the
paper's `tables/` folder, and the estimates behind them, with the other numbers the text quotes (apart from the appendix's three counts of
2025 graduates, which stay outside this package; the README gives their source), at full precision into
`out_dir/numbers/mechanisms_estimates.csv`:

* Table V in two files, `lottery_graduation_part1.tex` and `lottery_graduation_part2.tex` (Panel C carries the grade-stringency row), and
  `grade_stringency_facts.tex`, the text's numbers on grade stringency;
* Table VI, the college seat by admission track: `results/lottery_admission_tracks.tex` and its body `lottery_admission_tracks.tex`;
* Table VII, the application choices: `results/lottery_application_choices.tex` and `lottery_application_choices.tex`;
* Table VIII, the admission scores: `results/lottery_admission_scores.tex` and `lottery_admission_scores.tex`;
* Table IX, PACE and BEA: `pace_bea_access.tex`;
* Appendix Tables D.1 (`appendix_promotion_rules.tex`), D.2 (`appendix_failing_by_year.tex`) and D.3 (`appendix_pace_rules.tex`);
* `mechanisms_text_macros.tex`, the numbers the section's text and its appendix's text quote, as the LaTeX macros the paper prints
  (`out_dir/numbers/mechanisms_text_numbers.csv` lists them, one row per number; the text's Table IV numbers are the outcomes notebook's
  macros, its grade-stringency numbers those of `grade_stringency_facts.tex`, and the appendix's three counts of 2025 graduates stay typed);
  and `out_dir/numbers/mechanisms_text_claims.csv`, each statement the paper's text makes about these results, with whether it holds.

It reads the three data files of its data folder (parameter `data_dir`; by default the shared data folder), each checked against
`data_manifest.csv` beside the notebook; a relative `data_dir` or `out_dir` is taken from the notebook's folder. It needs fixest 0.14.2 or
later. Run it with `rmarkdown::render("mechanisms.Rmd", params = list(data_dir = "<the data folder>"))`; the README gives the other ways.

```{r setup, error = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(fixest)
library(data.table)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)   # a failed check stops the knit
KNIT_START <- Sys.time() - 2           # the chunk outputs checks that this knit wrote every output (two seconds for a file system's coarse clock)
if (getRversion() != "4.5.1") message("R ", getRversion(), " is not 4.5.1, the version this notebook's numbers come from")
# fixest 0.14.2 or later: with ssc(K.adj = FALSE) it gives the heteroskedasticity-robust 2SLS SEs the tables print; earlier versions can
# differ (0.12.1 keeps a factor n/(n-1))
if (packageVersion("fixest") < "0.14.2") stop("fixest 0.14.2 or later is required (this is ", packageVersion("fixest"), "): earlier versions compute a different robust SE")
if (packageVersion("fixest") > "0.14.2") message("fixest ", packageVersion("fixest"), " is newer than 0.14.2, the version this notebook's numbers come from")

if (!exists("params")) stop("params is missing: render the notebook with rmarkdown::render(), or knit it with a list params in its environment (README)")
# the notebook's own folder: data_manifest.csv is read from it, and a relative data_dir or out_dir is taken from it, whatever the folder the
# chunks run in (RStudio's Knit Directory); when the chunks are run one by one outside a knit, the working directory, which must hold the notebook
knitting <- !is.null(knitr::current_input())
nb_dir <- if (knitting) dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)) else normalizePath(".", winslash = "/")
if (!knitting && !file.exists(file.path(nb_dir, "mechanisms.Rmd"))) stop("the notebook's folder is not known: knit mechanisms.Rmd, or set the working directory to its folder")
is_absolute <- function(p) grepl("^(~|/|\\\\|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", p)   # a full path (a drive, a root, a network share or the home folder)
stopifnot("is_absolute self-test" = identical(is_absolute(c("C:/a", "c:\\a", "/a", "\\\\server\\a", "~/a", "output", "./a", "a/b", "C:a")),
                                              c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)))
from_notebook <- function(p) if (is_absolute(p)) path.expand(p) else file.path(nb_dir, p)
data_dir <- from_notebook(params$data_dir)   # the data folder
out_dir <- from_notebook(params$out_dir)     # the output folder ("output" beside the notebook by default)
# every input is required, each at the bytes and MD5 of data_manifest.csv beside this notebook; the data folder's own data_manifest.csv must
# list the same files, bytes and MD5s
manifest_file <- file.path(nb_dir, "data_manifest.csv")
if (!file.exists(manifest_file)) stop("data_manifest.csv is missing: it sits beside mechanisms.Rmd and lists the data files with their MD5s")
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) stop("the data folder is missing: ", data_dir, "; set the parameter data_dir to the folder that holds the data files")
read_manifest <- function(f) read.csv(f, colClasses = c(file = "character", bytes = "numeric", md5 = "character"))
manifest <- read_manifest(manifest_file)
inputs <- c("mechanisms_panel.rds", "mechanisms_schools.rds", "mechanisms_calibration.rds")
if (!setequal(manifest$file, inputs) || anyDuplicated(manifest$file)) stop("data_manifest.csv must list the three data files, each once: ", paste(inputs, collapse = ", "))
absent <- setdiff(c(inputs, "data_manifest.csv"), list.files(data_dir))
if (length(absent)) stop("the data folder ", data_dir, " lacks ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "), "; set the parameter data_dir to the folder that holds them")
if (!identical(read_manifest(file.path(data_dir, "data_manifest.csv")), manifest)) stop("the data folder's data_manifest.csv is not the one beside the notebook")
on_disk <- data.frame(file = manifest$file, bytes = file.size(file.path(data_dir, manifest$file)), md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(data_dir, manifest$file))))
differ <- on_disk$file[on_disk$bytes != manifest$bytes | on_disk$md5 != manifest$md5]
if (length(differ)) stop("not the data files data_manifest.csv records (bytes or MD5): ", paste(differ, collapse = ", "))
on_disk
panel <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "mechanisms_panel.rds"))               # one row per child of the lottery sample
schools <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "mechanisms_schools.rds"))           # one row per publicly funded school with a 12th grade and school year, 2019-2025
calibration <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "mechanisms_calibration.rds"))   # one row per grade-stringency calibration candidate (tenth grade, 2014-2016)
stopifnot("one row per child" = !anyDuplicated(panel$MRUN),
          "the design's columns are complete" = !anyNA(panel[c("MRUN", "YEAR", "CHANCE_GROUP", "OFFER", "D_OD")]),
          "the offer and attendance are 0/1" = all(panel$OFFER %in% 0:1) && all(panel$D_OD %in% 0:1),
          "each chance group is a whole number from 0 to 100" = all(panel$CHANCE_GROUP %in% 0:100),
          "the application years are 2016-2021" = identical(sort(unique(panel$YEAR)), 2016:2021))
dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "tables", "results"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir, "numbers"), showWarnings = FALSE)

setFixest_vcov(all = "hetero")            # robust SEs
setFixest_estimation(fixef.rm = "none")   # keep chance groups that hold a single child

controls <- c("GPA8_Z", "ES_MUJER", "PRIORITARIO", "ALTO", "ORIGIN_OD")
sample3 <- drop_na(panel, all_of(controls))   # the lottery sample with every characteristic (Table IV's children)
# the outcomes of Tables VII to IX come from runs on these children, and only on them
stopifnot(identical(!is.na(panel$PACE_SCHOOL_OT), complete.cases(panel[controls])), !anyDuplicated(sample3$MRUN))

stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.01, "$^{***}$", ifelse(p < 0.05, "$^{**}$", ifelse(p < 0.1, "$^{*}$", "")))
num <- function(x, d) sub("^-(0\\.0+)$", "\\1", sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), x))   # never "-0.00"
comma <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
tex_row <- function(label, cells) paste0(label, " & ", paste(cells, collapse = " & "), "\\\\")   # the lines of the paper's table files

# a constructed 0/1 flag: its share printed; it stops unless the flag takes both values
flag <- function(x, what) {
  if (anyNA(x) || !all(x %in% 0:1) || n_distinct(x) != 2L) stop(what, ": a 0/1 flag taking both values expected")
  message(sprintf("%s: share %.4f of %s", what, mean(x), comma(length(x))))
  invisible(x)
}

# each table file: the line saying where it comes from, then its lines; it stops on a missing or infinite number
no_missing <- function(tex) !any(grepl("(^|[^A-Za-z])(NA|NaN|Inf)([^A-Za-z]|$)", tex))
stopifnot("no_missing self-test" = no_missing("x & 1.00 & (0.39) DEMRE's NAME Info") && !no_missing("x & NA\\\\") && !no_missing("-Inf") && !no_missing("{NaN}"))
write_tex <- function(lines, file) {
  if (!no_missing(lines)) stop(file, ": a missing or infinite number")
  writeLines(c("% Generated by mechanisms.Rmd", lines), file.path(out_dir, "tables", file))
}

# coefficient on attendance (2SLS), SE, p-value and N, one row per model, the models' dependent variables y in their order (checked); p-values
# from the normal distribution, as ivreg2's
effect <- function(fit, y) {
  models <- if (inherits(fit, "fixest_multi")) as.list(fit) else list(fit)
  stopifnot(identical(unname(map_chr(models, function(m) deparse(m$fml[[2]]))), y),   # each model's dependent variable is its label
            all(map_lgl(models, function(m) length(m$collin.var) == 0L)))           # no regressor dropped
  bind_rows(map(models, function(m) {
    tibble(est = coef(m)[["fit_D_OD"]], se = se(m)[["fit_D_OD"]], p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(tstat(m)[["fit_D_OD"]])), n = nobs(m))
  }))
}

# each row of a table: 2SLS of the row on attendance with the offer as the instrument (Table IV's), on the children d who have it; the mean
# without an offer among them
tsls <- function(d, vars) {
  fit <- feols(.[vars] ~ .[controls] + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER, d,
               ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE))   # 2SLS SEs without the N/(N-K) factor, as ivreg2's robust
  est <- effect(fit, vars) %>%
    mutate(var = vars, mean = colMeans(d[d$OFFER == 0, vars, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
           n0 = map_int(vars, function(v) sum(d$OFFER == 0 & !is.na(d[[v]]))))
  stopifnot(all(est$n == map_int(vars, function(v) sum(!is.na(d[[v]])))))   # every student with the row is used
  est
}

# a row's two lines in a table of mean and estimate (with stars) on time and ever, or in one pair of columns (d decimals; x the scale)
row_lines <- function(est, label, vars, d = 2, x = 100, cells = 4) {
  r <- map(vars, function(v) { e <- filter(est, var == .env$v); stopifnot(nrow(e) == 1L); e })
  top <- unlist(map(r, function(e) c(num(x * e$mean, d), paste0(num(x * e$est, d), stars(e$p)))))
  ses <- unlist(map(r, function(e) c("", paste0("(", num(x * e$se, d), ")"))))
  pad <- rep("", cells - length(top))
  c(tex_row(label, c(top, pad)), tex_row("", c(ses, pad)))
}
panel_title <- function(title, ncol = 5) sprintf("\\multicolumn{%d}{l}{\\textit{%s}}\\\\", ncol, title)
# a panel's N line: the children without an offer and all children, one N per panel (on time and ever, or one pair of columns)
n_lines <- function(est, both) {
  n0 <- unique(est$n0); n <- unique(est$n)
  stopifnot(length(n0) == 1L, length(n) == 1L)   # one N per panel
  tex_row("$N$", c(comma(n0), comma(n), if (both) c(comma(n0), comma(n)) else c("", "")))
}
head_on_time_ever <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcccc}",
  "\\toprule",
  " & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{On time} & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{Ever}\\\\",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){2-3}\\cmidrule(lr){4-5}",
  " & No offer & 2SLS & No offer & 2SLS\\\\",
  " & mean &  & mean & \\\\",
  " & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4)\\\\",
  "\\midrule"
)
```

# Table V: why graduation falls

Graduation on top; Panel A, the reasons a student does not graduate; Panel B, what her failed years show; Panel C, the school she attends;
Panel D, how she does in 9th grade. Panels A and B are on every student with every characteristic, each row 0 for a graduate; Panel C on
those with an entry school and its three measures (the grade-stringency row on those whose entry school has the historical index); Panel D
on those with a percentile at the start and at the end of 9th grade.

```{r graduation}
grad <- c("GRAD_OT", "GRAD_EVER")
reasons <- c(FAILNG = "Failed a year", WDNG = "Withdrew", OTHNG = "Other")
failing <- c(PB_G = "Grades", PB_A = "Attendance alone", PB_U = "Attendance, grades unknown")
vars5 <- c(grad, paste0(names(reasons), "_OT"), paste0(names(reasons), "_EVER"), paste0(names(failing), "_OT"), paste0(names(failing), "_EVER"))
walk(vars5, function(v) flag(sample3[[v]], v))
# Panels A and B count only the students who did not graduate within the horizon: each of their rows is 0 for a graduate
stopifnot("Panels A and B: each row is 0 for a student who graduated within the horizon" =
            all(map_lgl(c("_OT", "_EVER"), function(h) all(as.matrix(sample3[sample3[[paste0("GRAD", h)]] == 1L, paste0(c(names(reasons), names(failing)), h)]) == 0L))))
est5 <- tsls(sample3, vars5)

# Panel C: the distance capped at its 99th percentile among the students with every characteristic
cap <- unname(quantile(sample3$DIST_HOME_KM, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7))
school <- c(CLASS_SIZE = "Class size (students)", STUDENT_TEACHER = "Students per teacher at the school", DIST_P99 = "Distance to school (km)")
sample_c <- sample3 %>%
  mutate(DIST_P99 = pmin(DIST_HOME_KM, cap)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENTRY_RBD), !is.na(CLASS_SIZE), !is.na(STUDENT_TEACHER), !is.na(DIST_P99))
est5c <- tsls(sample_c, names(school))

# Panel D: the percentile at the end of 9th grade, its change from the start, the bottom fifth
ninth <- c(FAILED_9 = "Failed 9th grade (\\%)", RANK9 = "Percentile at the end of 9th grade", CHANGE = "Change in percentile during 9th grade",
           BOTTOM20 = "Ended 9th grade in the bottom fifth of the class (\\%)")
sample_d <- sample3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(START_RANK), !is.na(RANK9)) %>%
  mutate(CHANGE = RANK9 - START_RANK, BOTTOM20 = as.integer(RANK9 <= 20))
flag(sample_d$FAILED_9, "FAILED_9"); flag(sample_d$BOTTOM20, "BOTTOM20")
est5d <- tsls(sample_d, names(ninth))
c(cap_km = cap, panel_c = nrow(sample_c), panel_d = nrow(sample_d))
# the text's share: of the students of Panel D who fail 9th grade, those who end it in the bottom fifth of their class (%)
failed_9 <- sample_d$FAILED_9 == 1L
bottom_among_failed <- tibble(failed = sum(failed_9), share_pct = 100 * mean(sample_d$BOTTOM20[failed_9] == 1L))   # the count stays an integer
bottom_among_failed
```

## Grade stringency (Table V, Panel C, and the text's numbers)

The grade-stringency index is a historical grading index for each school, from the
school fixed effects of a regression of tenth-grade GPA in the 2014-2016 cohorts on sex, cohort indicators and, within each cohort, natural
splines (four degrees of freedom) of the standardized SIMCE mathematics and reading scores and their product; the effects centered with
equal school weights, their sign reversed (higher is stricter), and shrunk by a scalar empirical Bayes weight. The calibration keeps publicly funded schools never fee-paying in 2012-2025 with at least 20 students across at least two
cohorts. Each lottery child gets the index of the school she attends in April of the entry year; the row is the 2SLS of Table IV on the
children whose school has it. The robustness numbers: the unshrunk index and the index fitted without one cohort, which the text quotes,
and a refit on the mathematics-reading cells where both groups of schools have at least 20 students, written to the estimates file and to
`grade_stringency_facts.tex` but not quoted by the text (the knit prints how many calibration rows that restriction keeps).

```{r grade-stringency}
# ---- Ignacio Rios's grade-stringency functions, unchanged ----
.stringency_centered_fe_hc0 <- function(X, residual, group, n_group) {
  # OLS with school indicators Z and nuisance regressors X. After centering the
  # school effects with equal school weights, the influence of observation i on
  # school s is 1{g_i=s}/n_s - 1/(J*n_g_i) - D_s' A^{-1} x_tilde_i.
  # The algebra below computes its squared-residual weighted norm without an
  # N by J influence matrix or a J by J fixed-effect covariance matrix.
  J <- length(n_group)
  p <- ncol(X)
  if (J < 2L || p < 1L) stop("Need at least two schools and one nuisance regressor.")
  if (nrow(X) != length(residual) || length(group) != nrow(X)) {
    stop("Inconsistent matrix, residual, or grouping lengths.")
  }
  xbar <- rowsum(X, group, reorder = FALSE) / n_group
  X_tilde <- X - xbar[group, , drop = FALSE]
  Ainv <- chol2inv(chol(crossprod(X_tilde)))
  residual2 <- residual^2
  weighted_X <- X_tilde * residual
  V_beta <- Ainv %*% crossprod(weighted_X) %*% Ainv
  rm(weighted_X)
  B <- rowsum(X_tilde * residual2, group, reorder = FALSE) / n_group
  h <- as.numeric(rowsum(residual2, group, reorder = FALSE)) / n_group^2
  D <- sweep(xbar, 2L, colMeans(xbar), "-")
  B_centered <- sweep(B, 2L, colMeans(B), "-")
  V <- (1 - 2 / J) * h + sum(h) / J^2 +
    rowSums((D %*% V_beta) * D) -
    2 * rowSums((D %*% Ainv) * B_centered)
  tolerance <- 1e-10 * max(1, max(abs(V)))
  if (any(!is.finite(V)) || any(V < -tolerance)) {
    stop("Centered fixed-effect HC0 variance is nonfinite or materially negative.")
  }
  list(variance = pmax(V, 0), nuisance_vcov_hc0 = V_beta,
       school_regressor_means = xbar)
}

fit_grade_stringency <- function(data, shrink = TRUE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE) ||
      !requireNamespace("fixest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("The data.table and fixest packages are required.")
  }
  if (length(shrink) != 1L || is.na(shrink) || !is.logical(shrink)) {
    stop("shrink must be TRUE or FALSE.")
  }
  data.table::setDTthreads(4L)
  required <- c("MRUN", "AGNO", "RBD", "math", "reading", "female",
                "COD_ENSE", "PROM_GRAL", "SIT_FIN_R")
  if (!all(required %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Missing calibration columns: ", paste(setdiff(required, names(data)), collapse = ", "))
  }
  d <- data.table::as.data.table(data.table::copy(data))[, ..required]
  numeric_required <- setdiff(required, "SIT_FIN_R")
  if (!all(vapply(d[, ..numeric_required], is.numeric, logical(1)))) {
    stop("Identifier, score, sex, teaching-code and GPA columns must be numeric.")
  }
  if (anyNA(d) || any(!is.finite(as.matrix(d[, ..numeric_required])))) {
    stop("Calibration data must have complete finite values before fitting.")
  }
  if (any(d$MRUN <= 0 | d$RBD <= 0 | d$PROM_GRAL < 1 | d$PROM_GRAL > 7) ||
      any(!d$female %in% 0:1) || any(!d$SIT_FIN_R %in% c("P", "R"))) {
    stop("Invalid identifiers, GPA, sex or final-status values in calibration data.")
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(d[, c("MRUN", "AGNO"), with = FALSE])) {
    stop("Calibration data contain duplicate student-year records.")
  }
  years <- sort(unique(d$AGNO))
  school_ids <- sort(unique(d$RBD))
  J <- length(school_ids)
  if (J < 2L) stop("At least two schools are required.")

  # Sorting ensures rowsum(reorder=FALSE) aligns with school_ids, n_group and
  # the integer group vector used in the influence-function calculation.
  data.table::setorderv(d, c("RBD", "AGNO", "MRUN"))
  group <- match(d$RBD, school_ids)
  n_group <- tabulate(group, nbins = J)
  if (any(n_group < 2L)) {
    stop("Prefilter calibration schools to at least two matched records; the main pipeline may impose a stronger rule.")
  }
  basis_names <- character()
  transformation <- list()
  for (yr in years) {
    ii <- which(d$AGNO == yr)
    score_z <- list()
    transformation[[as.character(yr)]] <- list()
    for (subject in c("math", "reading")) {
      values <- d[[subject]][ii]
      mu <- mean(values)
      sig <- stats::sd(values)
      if (length(values) < 10L || !is.finite(sig) || sig <= 0 ||
          length(unique(values)) < 5L) {
        stop("Insufficient score variation for four-degree splines in year ", yr)
      }
      z <- (values - mu) / sig
      score_z[[subject]] <- z
      basis <- splines::ns(z, df = 4L, intercept = FALSE)
      transformation[[as.character(yr)]][[subject]] <- list(
        mean = mu, sd = sig, df = 4L,
        knots = unname(attr(basis, "knots")),
        boundary_knots = unname(attr(basis, "Boundary.knots")))
      for (k in seq_len(ncol(basis))) {
        nm <- paste0(subject, "_ns", k, "_y", yr)
        data.table::set(d, j = nm, value = 0)
        data.table::set(d, i = ii, j = nm, value = basis[, k])
        basis_names <- c(basis_names, nm)
      }
    }
    nm <- paste0("math_reading_y", yr)
    data.table::set(d, j = nm, value = 0)
    data.table::set(d, i = ii, j = nm,
                    value = score_z$math * score_z$reading)
    basis_names <- c(basis_names, nm)
  }
  # Explicit year indicators keep the school effects' normalization transparent.
  year_names <- character()
  for (yr in years[-1L]) {
    nm <- paste0("year_", yr)
    data.table::set(d, j = nm, value = as.numeric(d$AGNO == yr))
    year_names <- c(year_names, nm)
  }
  nuisance <- c("female", year_names, basis_names)
  fml <- stats::as.formula(paste("PROM_GRAL ~", paste(nuisance, collapse = " + "), "| RBD"))
  fit <- fixest::feols(fml, data = d, nthreads = 4L, fixef.rm = "none",
                       fixef.tol = 1e-10, collin.tol = 1e-10,
                       mem.clean = TRUE, notes = FALSE, warn = FALSE)
  if (stats::nobs(fit) != nrow(d)) stop("The regression silently dropped calibration records.")
  beta <- stats::coef(fit)
  if (length(beta) == 0L) stop("No identified nuisance regressors.")
  # Explicitly retain only the estimable RHS columns, after fixest's collinearity
  # removal. No dense school-indicator matrix is created in the empirical fit.
  X <- as.matrix(d[, names(beta), with = FALSE])
  residual <- stats::residuals(fit)
  theta_all <- fixest::fixef(fit, notes = FALSE)$RBD
  theta <- unname(theta_all[match(as.character(school_ids), names(theta_all))])
  if (anyNA(theta)) stop("A calibration school's fixed effect is missing.")
  centered_theta <- theta - mean(theta)
  variance <- .stringency_centered_fe_hc0(X, residual, group, n_group)
  V <- variance$variance
  noise_variance <- sum(V) / (J - 1L)
  tau2 <- max(stats::var(centered_theta) - noise_variance, 0)
  reliability <- if (tau2 == 0) rep(0, J) else tau2 / (tau2 + V)
  theta_eb <- reliability * centered_theta
  theta_eb <- theta_eb - mean(theta_eb)
  index <- if (shrink) -theta_eb else -centered_theta
  schools <- data.table::data.table(
    RBD = school_ids, n_calibration = n_group,
    theta = theta, theta_centered = centered_theta,
    theta_var_hc0 = V, theta_se_hc0 = sqrt(V),
    reliability = reliability, theta_eb = theta_eb,
    GRADE_STRINGENCY = index,
    GRADE_STRINGENCY_UNSHRUNK = -centered_theta)
  stopifnot(abs(mean(schools$GRADE_STRINGENCY)) < 1e-10,
            abs(mean(schools$GRADE_STRINGENCY_UNSHRUNK)) < 1e-10,
            all(is.finite(schools$GRADE_STRINGENCY)),
            all(schools$reliability >= 0 & schools$reliability <= 1))
  fit_metadata <- list(
    n_calibration = nrow(d), n_schools = J, years = years,
    n_by_year = d[, .(n = .N), by = AGNO][order(AGNO)],
    n_by_status = d[, .(n = .N), by = SIT_FIN_R][order(SIT_FIN_R)],
    specification = paste(deparse(fml), collapse = " "),
    standardization = "Subject scores standardized using mean and sample SD within calibration year.",
    spline = "Natural cubic spline, df=4, separately for subject and year; year-specific standardized math x reading product.",
    transformations = transformation,
    coefficients = beta,
    omitted_collinear_terms = setdiff(nuisance, names(beta)),
    nuisance_vcov_hc0 = variance$nuisance_vcov_hc0,
    centering = "Equal weight to each calibration school; recentered after shrinkage.",
    tau2 = tau2, observed_school_variance = stats::var(centered_theta),
    sampling_variance_correction = noise_variance,
    shrink = shrink,
    shrinkage = "Scalar empirical Bayes approximation: tau2=max(var(centered school FE)-sum(centered FE HC0 variances)/(J-1),0); reliability=tau2/(tau2+variance). Cross-school covariances are not used in the scalar weights.",
    historical_variance = "Centered school-FE HC0 sandwich includes common-slope uncertainty; conditional on observed covariates and spline knots.",
    uncertainty_caveat = "Empirical Bayes prior variance and weights are estimated; their uncertainty is not propagated. This helper supplies no lottery-stage standard errors.",
    residual_rmse = sqrt(mean(residual^2)),
    largest_absolute_school_mean_residual = max(abs(as.numeric(rowsum(residual, group, reorder = FALSE)) / n_group)),
    threads_requested = 4L,
    package_versions = c(fixest = as.character(utils::packageVersion("fixest")),
                         data.table = as.character(utils::packageVersion("data.table"))))
  list(schools = schools, metadata = fit_metadata)
}

verify_grade_stringency_covariance <- function(tolerance = 1e-9) {
  # Deterministic numerical verification of the algebra, separate from the
  # empirical estimation. Compare with full-dummy OLS HC0 on an unbalanced
  # example. No random draws, empirical estimates, or manuscript exports occur.
  n_group <- c(8L, 10L, 11L, 13L, 9L, 12L)
  J <- length(n_group)
  group <- rep(seq_len(J), n_group)
  i <- seq_along(group)
  X <- cbind(x1 = sin(i / 3) + group / 5,
             x2 = cos(i / 7) + group / 10,
             x3 = i %% 5)
  Z <- stats::model.matrix(~ factor(group) - 1)
  W <- cbind(Z, X)
  y <- group * 0.3 + X[, 1] * 0.2 - X[, 2] * 0.1 + X[, 3] * 0.05 +
    sin(i * 1.7) * (1 + group / 10)
  direct <- stats::lm.fit(W, y)
  Winv <- chol2inv(chol(crossprod(W)))
  V_full <- Winv %*% crossprod(W * direct$residuals) %*% Winv
  C <- diag(J) - matrix(1 / J, J, J)
  expected <- diag(C %*% V_full[seq_len(J), seq_len(J)] %*% t(C))
  computed <- .stringency_centered_fe_hc0(X, direct$residuals, group, n_group)$variance
  error <- max(abs(expected - computed))
  if (!is.finite(error) || error > tolerance * max(1, max(abs(expected)))) {
    stop("Centered FE covariance failed the full-dummy HC0 comparison: ", error)
  }
  list(passed = TRUE, maximum_absolute_difference = error,
       tolerance = tolerance, reference = "Full-dummy OLS HC0, deterministic unbalanced groups")
}

iv_result <- function(variable, label, sample = lot) {
  dd <- sample[!is.na(get(variable))]
  f <- as.formula(paste(variable, "~", paste(controls, collapse = " + "),
    "+ i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP | D_OD ~ OFFER"))
  fit <- feols(f, dd, vcov = "hetero", ssc = ssc(K.adj = FALSE),
               fixef.rm = "none", notes = FALSE)
  stopifnot(nobs(fit) == nrow(dd))
  b <- coef(fit)[["fit_D_OD"]]; s <- se(fit)[["fit_D_OD"]]
  data.table(specification = label, mean = dd[OFFER == 0, mean(get(variable))],
    est = b, se = s, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(b / s)), n = nrow(dd),
    n_nooffer = dd[OFFER == 0, .N])
}
main <- iv_result("GRADE_STRINGENCY", "Baseline: shrunk historical school effects")
stringency <- rbind(main, iv_result("GRADE_STRINGENCY_UNSHRUNK", "Unshrunk historical school effects"))
# whether the index is observed, on the offer (reduced form, Stata-robust SEs)
availability <- feols(HAS_STRINGENCY ~ OFFER + GPA8_Z + ES_MUJER + PRIORITARIO + ALTO +
  ORIGIN_OD + i(YEAR, ref = 2016) | CHANCE_GROUP, lot, vcov = "hetero",
  fixef.rm = "none", notes = FALSE)
availability_result <- data.table(outcome = "Stringency observed", n = nobs(availability),
  mean_nooffer = lot[OFFER == 0, mean(HAS_STRINGENCY)],
  offer_effect = coef(availability)[["OFFER"]], se = se(availability)[["OFFER"]],
  p = pvalue(availability)[["OFFER"]])

# ---- leave one calibration cohort out ----
for (excluded_year in 2014:2016) {
  dd <- d[AGNO != excluded_year]
  counts <- dd[, .N, by = RBD]
  dd <- dd[RBD %in% counts[N >= 2L, RBD]]
  fit <- fit_grade_stringency(dd)
  name <- paste0("STRINGENCY_EXCLUDING_", excluded_year)
  lookup <- fit$schools[, .(RBD, value = GRADE_STRINGENCY)]
  lot[lookup, on = .(ENTRY_RBD = RBD), (name) := i.value]
  stopifnot(identical(lot[[name]], lookup$value[match(lot$ENTRY_RBD, lookup$RBD)]))   # the join recounted by match()
}
loo_columns <- paste0("STRINGENCY_EXCLUDING_", 2014:2016)
common_panel <- lot[complete.cases(lot[, c("GRADE_STRINGENCY", loo_columns), with = FALSE])]
stringency <- rbind(stringency, rbindlist(lapply(2014:2016, function(yr)
  iv_result(paste0("STRINGENCY_EXCLUDING_", yr), paste("Exclude historical cohort", yr), common_panel))))

# ---- refit on a score region with observations from both school groups in each historical year; no full-sample effect is used to select
#      the restriction ----
support <- copy(d)
support[, math_cell := pmin(5L, as.integer(ceiling(frank(math, ties.method = "average") / .N * 5))), by = AGNO]
support[, reading_cell := pmin(5L, as.integer(ceiling(frank(reading, ties.method = "average") / .N * 5))), by = AGNO]
cells <- support[, .(n = .N), by = .(AGNO, math_cell, reading_cell, over_demanded)]
keep_cells <- cells[, .(both_groups = uniqueN(over_demanded) == 2L,
                       minimum_group_n = min(n)), by = .(AGNO, math_cell, reading_cell)]
keep_cells <- keep_cells[both_groups == TRUE & minimum_group_n >= 20L]
support <- support[keep_cells, on = .(AGNO, math_cell, reading_cell), nomatch = 0]
counts <- support[, .(n = .N, n_years = uniqueN(AGNO)), by = RBD]
support <- support[RBD %in% counts[n >= 20L & n_years >= 2L, RBD]]
message(sprintf("the common-support refit keeps %s of the %s calibration rows", comma(nrow(support)), comma(nrow(d))))
supported_fit <- fit_grade_stringency(support)
lookup <- supported_fit$schools[, .(RBD, value = GRADE_STRINGENCY)]
lot[lookup, on = .(ENTRY_RBD = RBD), STRINGENCY_COMMON_SUPPORT := i.value]
stopifnot(identical(lot$STRINGENCY_COMMON_SUPPORT, lookup$value[match(lot$ENTRY_RBD, lookup$RBD)]))   # the join recounted by match()
common_support_panel <- lot[!is.na(STRINGENCY_COMMON_SUPPORT) & !is.na(GRADE_STRINGENCY)]

  iv_result("STRINGENCY_COMMON_SUPPORT", "Common math-reading support calibration", common_support_panel))

number <- function(x, digits = 0L) formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f", big.mark = ",")
facts <- c(
  GSCalibrationN = number(nrow(d)), GSSchoolN = number(uniqueN(d$RBD)),
  GSFailureN = number(sum(d$SIT_FIN_R == "R")), GSLotteryN = number(nrow(lot)),
  GSObservedN = number(main$n), GSNoOfferN = number(main$n_nooffer),

  GSLOOMax = number(max(stringency[grepl("^Exclude historical", specification), est]), 3),
  GSUnshrunkEffect = number(stringency[specification == "Unshrunk historical school effects", est], 3),
  GSSupportEffect = number(stringency[specification == "Common math-reading support calibration", est], 3))
fact_lines <- sprintf("\\newcommand{\\%s}{%s}", names(facts), facts)
```

```{r graduation-tex}
# the grade-stringency row and its sample size, placed in Panel C: the row (between its two comment marks) after the distance row, its N
# (between its two comment marks) after Panel C's N
add_stringency <- function(lines, result) {
  required <- c("mean", "est", "se", "p", "n", "n_nooffer")
  values <- lapply(required, function(key) result[[key]])
  names(values) <- required
  stopifnot(all(vapply(values, function(x) is.numeric(x) && length(x) == 1L && is.finite(x), logical(1L))),
            values$se >= 0, values$p >= 0, values$p <= 1,
            all(unlist(values[c("n", "n_nooffer")]) >= 0), all(unlist(values[c("n", "n_nooffer")]) == floor(unlist(values[c("n", "n_nooffer")]))),
            values$n_nooffer <= values$n)
  c_index <- which(lines == panel_title("Panel C: Characteristics of the School They Attend"))
  d_index <- which(lines == panel_title("Panel D: Performance in the 9th grade"))
  stopifnot("one Panel C and one Panel D heading, in that order" = length(c_index) == 1L && length(d_index) == 1L && c_index < d_index,
            "no stringency row yet" = !any(grepl("stringency", lines, ignore.case = TRUE)))
  c_indices <- seq.int(c_index + 1L, d_index - 1L)
  distance <- c_indices[startsWith(lines[c_indices], "Distance to school (km) &")]
  stopifnot("one distance row in Panel C" = length(distance) == 1L)
  distance_se <- distance + 1L
  se_cells <- strsplit(lines[distance_se], "&", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  stopifnot("the distance row's SE line, then a rule" =
              length(se_cells) == 5L && trimws(se_cells[[1L]]) == "" && trimws(se_cells[[2L]]) == "" &&
              grepl("^\\([-+0-9.,]+\\)$", trimws(se_cells[[3L]])) && trimws(se_cells[[4L]]) == "" && trimws(se_cells[[5L]]) == "\\\\" &&
              distance_se + 1L < d_index && lines[distance_se + 1L] == "\\midrule")
  n_index <- c_indices[startsWith(lines[c_indices], "$N$ &")]
  stopifnot("one Panel C N line after the distance row, then a rule" =
              length(n_index) == 1L && n_index > distance_se && n_index + 1L < d_index && lines[n_index + 1L] == "\\midrule")
  decimal <- function(x) {
    out <- sprintf("%.3f", x)
    if (identical(out, "-0.000")) "0.000" else out
  }
  stars <- if (values$p < 0.01) "***" else if (values$p < 0.05) "**" else if (values$p < 0.10) "*" else ""
  estimate <- paste0(decimal(values$est), if (nzchar(stars)) paste0("$^{", stars, "}$") else "")
  outcome_rows <- c(
    paste0("Grade stringency (GPA points) & ", decimal(values$mean), " & ", estimate, " &  & \\\\"),
    paste0(" &  & (", decimal(values$se), ") &  & \\\\")
  )
  count <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, nsmall = 0L)
  sample_row <- paste0("$N$ (grade stringency) & ", count(values$n_nooffer), " & ", count(values$n), " &  & \\\\")
  # insert from bottom to top so both indices refer to the original table lines
  updated <- append(lines, c("% BEGIN GENERATED GRADE STRINGENCY SAMPLE SIZE", sample_row, "% END GENERATED GRADE STRINGENCY SAMPLE SIZE"),
                    after = n_index)
  append(updated, c("% BEGIN GENERATED GRADE STRINGENCY OUTCOME", outcome_rows, "% END GENERATED GRADE STRINGENCY OUTCOME"), after = distance_se)
}
tex5b <- add_stringency(tex5b, as.list(main))
write_tex(tex5a, "lottery_graduation_part1.tex")
write_tex(tex5b, "lottery_graduation_part2.tex")
cat(tex5a, tex5b, sep = "\n")
```

# Table VI: the college seat by admission track

Each assigned student counts once, under the track of her first recorded
assignment within the horizon (regular, BEA, PACE or the gender quota), so the four tracks add up to Table IV's college seat. The data
folder carries each child's first recorded assignment (its admission process and track) from the admission records of the processes
2018-2026; on time is by the fifth process after the application year, ever by the 2026 process. The sample and specification are Table
IV's.

```{r admission-tracks}
tracks <- c(ASSIGNED = "Total: assigned a college seat", REG = "Regular", BEA = "BEA", PACE = "PACE", GENERO = "Gender quota")
routes <- c("REG", "BEA", "PACE", "GENERO")
sample_t <- sample3
for (h in c("OT", "EVER")) {
  eligible <- !is.na(sample_t$FIRST_ASSIGNED_PROCESS) & sample_t$FIRST_ASSIGNED_PROCESS <= if (h == "OT") sample_t$YEAR + 5L else 2026L
  stopifnot(sum(eligible != sample_t[[paste0("ASSIGNED_", h)]]) == 0L)   # the first assignment in the horizon is Table IV's college seat
  for (r in routes) sample_t[[paste0(r, "_", h)]] <- as.integer(eligible & sample_t$FIRST_ASSIGNED_TRACK %in% r)
  stopifnot(all(rowSums(sample_t[paste0(routes, "_", h)]) == sample_t[[paste0("ASSIGNED_", h)]]))   # the four tracks partition the total
}
vars_t <- unlist(lapply(c("OT", "EVER"), function(h) paste0(names(tracks), "_", h)))
walk(vars_t, function(v) flag(sample_t[[v]], v))
est_t <- tsls(sample_t, vars_t)
additivity <- bind_rows(map(c("OT", "EVER"), function(h) {
  total <- filter(est_t, var == paste0("ASSIGNED_", h))
  parts <- filter(est_t, var %in% paste0(routes, "_", h))
  tibble(horizon = h, estimate_error = sum(100 * parts$est) - 100 * total$est, mean_error = sum(100 * parts$mean) - 100 * total$mean)
}))
stopifnot(max(abs(additivity$estimate_error)) < 1e-9, max(abs(additivity$mean_error)) < 1e-9,   # the tracks add to the total
          all(est_t$n == nrow(sample_t)))                                                         # N is the sample's count
additivity

# ever, each estimate and robust SE equal to the outcomes notebook's values of record (its numbers/outcomes_estimates.csv as written on

  of_record <- list(GRAD_OT = c(-0.031247278696618825, 0.0033514252152544565), GRAD_EVER = c(-0.0094057447897240264, 0.0025825161821881612),
                    ASSIGNED_OT = c(-0.023282059999731958, 0.0040473286987271996), ASSIGNED_EVER = c(-0.012002790882630046, 0.0042604440706998595))
  stopifnot("Table V's graduation is Table IV's, on time and ever (estimate and robust SE of record)" =
              all(map_lgl(c("GRAD_OT", "GRAD_EVER"), function(v) max(abs(shared(est5, v) - of_record[[v]])) < 1e-12)),
            "Table VI's total is Table IV's college seat, on time and ever (estimate and robust SE of record)" =
              all(map_lgl(c("ASSIGNED_OT", "ASSIGNED_EVER"), function(v) max(abs(shared(est_t, v) - of_record[[v]])) < 1e-12)))
} else message("the panel is another panel than the one of record: the rows shared with Table IV are not checked against its values of record")
# no gender-quota first assignment comes before the 2024 admission process, when the quota starts (Table VI's note)

# the regular-admission and PACE effects on time against each other (the text's "similar amounts"): the 2SLS of their difference

est_t_diff

  "\\small", "\\input{tables/lottery_admission_tracks.tex}", "\\par\\smallskip",

  "\\end{minipage}", "\\end{table}"
)
write_tex(tex_t, "lottery_admission_tracks.tex")
write_tex(wrapper_t, "results/lottery_admission_tracks.tex")
```

# Tables VII and VIII: the application choices and the admission scores

The rows come from two sets of estimates. The admission scores: each score among the students who have it, the highest reading--mathematics
mean, the NEM and the ranking scores (in standard deviations within the admission process); on time, from the admission processes up to
five years after the application year, NEM and ranking for the students who graduated by the fourth school year after it. The first
application list: each student's first regular application list in the horizon (the list, the application score at the listed programs
with its parts, and the listed cutoffs), among the students with such a list.

```{r admission-scores}
admission <- c(LM = "Math-Verbal", NEM = "NEM", RANKING = "Ranking")
vars6 <- c(paste0("SCORE_", names(admission), "_OT"), paste0("SCORE_", names(admission), "_EVER"))
est6 <- tsls(sample3, vars6)
stopifnot(all(est6$n[est6$var == "SCORE_NEM_OT"] == est6$n[est6$var == "SCORE_RANKING_OT"]),     # NEM and ranking on the same students
          all(est6$n[est6$var == "SCORE_NEM_EVER"] == est6$n[est6$var == "SCORE_RANKING_EVER"]))
tex6 <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcccccc}",
  "\\toprule",
  " & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{On time} & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{Ever}\\\\",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){2-4}\\cmidrule(lr){5-7}",
  " & No offer & 2SLS & $N$ & No offer & 2SLS & $N$\\\\",
  " & mean &  &  & mean &  & \\\\",
  " & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4) & (5) & (6)\\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  unlist(imap(admission, function(lbl, k) {
    r <- map(paste0("SCORE_", k, c("_OT", "_EVER")), function(v) { e <- filter(est6, var == .env$v); stopifnot(nrow(e) == 1L); e })
    c(tex_row(lbl, unlist(map(r, function(e) c(num(e$mean, 3), paste0(num(e$est, 3), stars(e$p)), comma(e$n))))),
      tex_row("", unlist(map(r, function(e) c("", paste0("(", num(e$se, 3), ")"), "")))))
  })),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}"
)

list_rows <- tribble(
  ~var,                      ~panel, ~label,                                                    ~digits,
  "LIST_PROGRAMS",           "A",    "\\quad Programs listed",                                  2,
  "LIST_MEAN_CUTOFF",        "A",    "\\quad Mean cutoff percentile of the listed programs",    2,
  "LIST_MAX_CUTOFF",         "A",    "\\quad Highest cutoff percentile among the listed programs", 2,
  "LIST_WEIGHT_NEM_RANKING", "A",    "\\quad Weight on NEM and Ranking (\\%)",                  2,
  "LIST_SCORE",              "B",    "\\quad Application score",                                3,
  "LIST_SCORE_NEM",          "B",    "\\quad\\quad NEM part",                                   3,
  "LIST_SCORE_RANKING",      "B",    "\\quad\\quad Ranking part",                               3,
  "LIST_SCORE_EXAMS",        "B",    "\\quad\\quad Exams part",                                 3,
  "LIST_SCORE_READING",      "B",    "\\quad\\quad\\quad Reading",                              3,
  "LIST_SCORE_MATH",         "B",    "\\quad\\quad\\quad Mathematics",                          3,
  "LIST_SCORE_HIST_SCIENCE", "B",    "\\quad\\quad\\quad History or science",                   3,
  "LIST_MISSED",             "C",    "\\quad Listed programs whose cutoff is missed (\\%)",     2,
  "LIST_REACHED",            "C",    "\\quad Reached at least one listed cutoff (\\%)",         2
)
vars7 <- c(paste0(list_rows$var, "_OT"), paste0(list_rows$var, "_EVER"))
est7 <- tsls(sample3, vars7)
stopifnot(n_distinct(est7$n[endsWith(est7$var, "_OT")]) == 1L, n_distinct(est7$n[endsWith(est7$var, "_EVER")]) == 1L,     # one N per horizon
          n_distinct(est7$n0[endsWith(est7$var, "_OT")]) == 1L, n_distinct(est7$n0[endsWith(est7$var, "_EVER")]) == 1L)
# Table VIII's note: the application score's three parts add up to it, and the exams part is the sum of its three scores (estimates and
# means without an offer, on time and ever, before rounding)
add_up <- function(total, parts) all(map_lgl(c("_OT", "_EVER"), function(h) all(map_lgl(c("est", "mean"), function(field) {
  pick <- function(v) { x <- est7[[field]][est7$var == paste0(v, h)]; stopifnot(length(x) == 1L); x }
  abs(pick(total) - sum(map_dbl(parts, pick))) < 1e-9
}))))
stopifnot("Table VIII: the application score's NEM, Ranking and exams parts add up to it" = add_up("LIST_SCORE", c("LIST_SCORE_NEM", "LIST_SCORE_RANKING", "LIST_SCORE_EXAMS")),
          "Table VIII: the exams part is the sum of its reading, mathematics and history-or-science scores" =
            add_up("LIST_SCORE_EXAMS", c("LIST_SCORE_READING", "LIST_SCORE_MATH", "LIST_SCORE_HIST_SCIENCE")))
lines7 <- function(p) unlist(map(which(list_rows$panel == p), function(i) {
  r <- list_rows[i, ]
  row_lines(est7, r$label, paste0(r$var, c("_OT", "_EVER")), d = r$digits, x = 1)
}))
n7 <- map(c("_OT", "_EVER"), function(h) filter(est7, endsWith(var, .env$h))[1, ])
tex7 <- c(
  head_on_time_ever,
  panel_title("Panel A. The application list"),
  lines7("A"),
  "\\midrule",
  panel_title("Panel B. Application score at the listed programs (SD)"),
  lines7("B"),
  "\\midrule",
  panel_title("Panel C. The listed cutoffs"),
  lines7("C"),
  "\\midrule",
  tex_row("$N$", unlist(map(n7, function(e) c(comma(e$n0), comma(e$n))))),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}"
)

# the admission-scores note: of the students with both NEM and Ranking ever, those whose two scores are DEMRE's official ones (the rest are
# computed from school records)
both_ever <- !is.na(sample3$SCORE_NEM_EVER) & !is.na(sample3$SCORE_RANKING_EVER)
stopifnot(identical(!is.na(sample3$SCORE_NEM_RANKING_EVER_OFFICIAL), both_ever), sum(both_ever) == est6$n[est6$var == "SCORE_NEM_EVER"])
n_both <- sum(both_ever)
n_official <- sum(sample3$SCORE_NEM_RANKING_EVER_OFFICIAL[both_ever])
c(official = n_official, both = n_both)
```

The two tables are assembled from these rows: Table VII takes the list's
Panel A; Table VIII takes the scores (Panel A) and the application score with its parts (Panel B), each with its N, and keeps the listed
cutoffs as comment lines. Every estimate, standard error and star is copied from the rows above.

```{r merge-admission-tables}
scores_text <- paste(tex6, collapse = "\n")
applications_text <- paste(tex7, collapse = "\n")
# the text between the marker start and the first marker end after it, each marker once in the text
between_text <- function(text, start, end) {
  count <- function(s) sum(gregexpr(s, text, fixed = TRUE)[[1L]] > 0L)   # occurrences of s (gregexpr gives -1 for none)
  stopifnot(count(start) == 1L, count(end) == 1L)
  after <- substring(text, regexpr(start, text, fixed = TRUE) + nchar(start))
  stopifnot(regexpr(end, after, fixed = TRUE) > 0L)
  substr(after, 1L, regexpr(end, after, fixed = TRUE) - 1L)
}
# the table rows of a text: lines with a cell, other than panel titles and N lines
data_rows <- function(text) {
  lines <- strsplit(text, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  lines[grepl("&", lines, fixed = TRUE) & !startsWith(lines, "\\multicolumn") & !startsWith(lines, "$N$")]
}
# a line's cells: the line without its closing row break, split at each &, each cell without its surrounding spaces, a trailing empty cell kept
cells_of <- function(line) {
  if (endsWith(line, "\\\\")) line <- substr(line, 1L, nchar(line) - 2L)
  cells <- strsplit(line, "&", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  if (endsWith(line, "&")) cells <- c(cells, "")
  trimws(cells)
}
stopifnot("between_text self-test" = identical(between_text("a<x>b<y>c", "<x>", "<y>"), "b") &&
            inherits(tryCatch(between_text("<x>a<x>b<y>", "<x>", "<y>"), error = function(e) e), "error"),
          "data_rows self-test" = identical(data_rows("\\multicolumn{5}{l}{x} & y\nA & 1\\\\\nno cell\n$N$ & 2\\\\\n & (3)\\\\"), c("A & 1\\\\", " & (3)\\\\")),
          "cells_of self-test" = identical(cells_of(" &  & (0.01) &  & \\\\"), c("", "", "(0.01)", "", "")) &&
            identical(cells_of("A & 1 &"), c("A", "1", "")) && identical(cells_of("$N$ & 1,234 & 5\\\\"), c("$N$", "1,234", "5")))
score_rows <- data_rows(between_text(scores_text, "\\midrule", "\\bottomrule"))
choice_rows <- data_rows(between_text(applications_text, "\\textit{Panel A. The application list}}\\\\",
                                      "\\textit{Panel B. Application score at the listed programs (SD)}}\\\\"))
application_score_rows <- data_rows(between_text(applications_text, "\\textit{Panel B. Application score at the listed programs (SD)}}\\\\",
                                                 "\\textit{Panel C. The listed cutoffs}}\\\\"))
cutoff_rows <- data_rows(between_text(applications_text, "\\textit{Panel C. The listed cutoffs}}\\\\", "\\bottomrule"))
stopifnot(identical(lengths(list(score_rows, choice_rows, application_score_rows, cutoff_rows)), c(6L, 8L, 14L, 4L)))
app_n <- tex7[startsWith(tex7, "$N$")]
stopifnot(length(app_n) == 1L)
app_n_cells <- cells_of(app_n)
stopifnot(length(app_n_cells) == 5L)
no_offer_ot <- app_n_cells[2L]; total_ot <- app_n_cells[3L]; no_offer_ever <- app_n_cells[4L]; total_ever <- app_n_cells[5L]

# Table VII: application choices among regular-track applicants
header4 <- c("\\begin{tabular}{lcccc}", "\\toprule",
             " & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{On time} & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{Ever}\\\\",
             "\\cmidrule(lr){2-3}\\cmidrule(lr){4-5}",
             " & No offer & 2SLS & No offer & 2SLS\\\\",
             " & mean &  & mean & \\\\", " & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4)\\\\")
choices <- c(header4, "\\midrule", choice_rows, "\\midrule", app_n, "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}")
write_tex(choices, "lottery_application_choices.tex")

# Table VIII: individual scores and weighted application scores, with N columns identifying the applicant sample on each row; the cutoff
# panel kept as comments
with_sample_sizes <- function(rows, labels = NULL) {
  expanded <- character(length(rows))
  for (i in seq_along(rows)) {
    cells <- cells_of(rows[[i]])
    stopifnot(length(cells) == 5L)
    if (!is.null(labels) && cells[[1L]] %in% names(labels)) cells[[1L]] <- labels[[cells[[1L]]]]
    n_cells <- if (i %% 2L == 1L) c(total_ot, total_ever) else c("", "")   # the first line of each row carries the N
    expanded[[i]] <- paste0(paste(c(cells[1:3], n_cells[[1L]], cells[4:5], n_cells[[2L]]), collapse = " & "), "\\\\")
    stopifnot(identical(cells_of(expanded[[i]])[c(1L, 2L, 3L, 5L, 6L)], cells))
  }
  expanded
}
expanded_application_rows <- with_sample_sizes(application_score_rows)
expanded_cutoff_rows <- with_sample_sizes(cutoff_rows, c(
  "\\quad Listed programs whose cutoff is missed (\\%)" = "\\quad Listed cutoffs missed (\\%)",
  "\\quad Reached at least one listed cutoff (\\%)" = "\\quad Reached a listed cutoff (\\%)"))
HEADER6 <- c("\\begin{tabular}{lcccccc}", "\\toprule", " & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{On time} & \\multicolumn{3}{c}{Ever}\\\\",
             "\\cmidrule(lr){2-4}\\cmidrule(lr){5-7}", " & No offer & 2SLS & $N$ & No offer & 2SLS & $N$\\\\", " & mean &  &  & mean &  & \\\\",
             " & (1) & (2) & (3) & (4) & (5) & (6)\\\\")
header6 <- strsplit(trimws(strsplit(scores_text, "\\midrule", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]][[1L]]), "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
stopifnot(identical(header6, HEADER6))
panel_block <- function(title, rows, columns = 5L) c("\\midrule", panel_title(title, columns), rows)
combined_scores <- c(header6,
                     panel_block("Panel A. Individual admission scores (SD)", score_rows, 7L),
                     panel_block("Panel B. Application score at the listed programs (SD)", expanded_application_rows, 7L),
                     paste0("% ", panel_block("Panel C. Cutoff attainment at listed programs", expanded_cutoff_rows, 7L)),
                     "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}")
write_tex(combined_scores, "lottery_admission_scores.tex")

wrapper <- function(name, caption, label, body, notes, spacing) {
  write_tex(c("\\begin{table}[htp!]", paste0("\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{", spacing, "}"), "\\centering",
              paste0("\\caption{{", caption, "}}\\label{", label, "}"), "\\small", "\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{6pt}",
              paste0("\\input{tables/", body, "}"), "\\par\\smallskip", "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
              paste0("{Notes: ", notes, "}"), "\\end{minipage}", "\\end{table}"),
            file.path("results", name))
}
wrapper("lottery_application_choices.tex", "Effect of Attending an Over-Demanded School on Application Choices",
        "tab: lottery application choices", "lottery_application_choices.tex",
        paste0("2SLS estimates with the specification of Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}; means among students without an offer. ",
               "Effects are in program counts, cutoff percentiles, or percentage points as indicated. ",
               "A cutoff percentile ranks the program's cutoff among the process's programs. ",
               "On time and ever are defined in Section~\\ref{sec:lottery-data}. ",
               "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. $^{***}p<0.01$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{*}p<0.1$."),
        "1.2")
wrapper("lottery_admission_scores.tex", "Effect of Attending an Over-Demanded School on Admission Scores",
        "tab: lottery scores", "lottery_admission_scores.tex",
        paste0("2SLS estimates as in Table~\\ref{tab: lottery college}; means among students without an offer. ",
               "Panel A uses students with both compulsory exam scores for Math-Verbal, and graduates with both NEM and Ranking for those rows. ",
               "NEM and Ranking are official for ", comma(n_official), " of the ", comma(n_both), " students ever, and computed from school records for the rest. ",
               "Panel B uses the applicants and first lists in Table~\\ref{tab: lottery application choices}; Panel B averages scores and components over listed programs. ",
               "Panel A is in SD of each score; Panel B is in SD of published application scores. Parts share the total's centering and scale and add to it before rounding. ",
               "Panel B includes ", no_offer_ot, " students without an offer on time, ", no_offer_ever, " ever. ",
               "Heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors in parentheses. $^{***}p<0.01$, $^{**}p<0.05$, $^{*}p<0.1$."),
        "1.0")
cat(choices, combined_scores, sep = "\n")
```

# Table IX: PACE and BEA

Each student with every characteristic, on time and ever: PACE's school condition (her grade-11 and grade-12 schools on the PACE list,
graduating from one), PACE's grade rule among her school's graduates, both, and BEA's grade rule (the Ministry's own record of the top
10% of her school's graduates by grade average). In "Met both", from the 2022 admission process on, the grade rule's places and rank
come from the classmates who meet the school condition, as the resolutions set it, so that row can differ from the product of the first
two. Each row is 0 for a student who does not graduate in the horizon, or whose records leave the condition undetermined.

The appendix checks these rows against the seats the students obtain (ever): a PACE seat in DEMRE's selections in any admission process
after the year of the graduation record her row reads, a BEA seat in the process right after it (the data folder's PACE_SEAT_EVER and
BEA_SEAT_EVER); of the holders of each seat, those who meet PACE's two conditions, or BEA's grade rule.

```{r pace-bea}
access <- c(PACE_SCHOOL = "\\quad Graduated from a PACE school", PACE_GRADE = "\\quad Met PACE's grade rule at her school",
            PACE_BOTH = "\\quad Met both", BEA_GRADE = "\\quad Met BEA's grade rule at her school")
vars8 <- c(paste0(names(access), "_OT"), paste0(names(access), "_EVER"))
walk(vars8, function(v) flag(sample3[[v]], v))
# Table IX's note: each row is 0 for a student who did not graduate within the horizon
stopifnot("Table IX: each row is 0 for a student who did not graduate within the horizon" =
            all(map_lgl(c("_OT", "_EVER"), function(h) all(as.matrix(sample3[sample3[[paste0("GRAD", h)]] == 0L, paste0(names(access), h)]) == 0L))))
est8 <- tsls(sample3, vars8)
lines8 <- function(keys) unlist(map(keys, function(k) row_lines(est8, access[[k]], paste0(k, c("_OT", "_EVER")))))
tex8 <- c(
  head_on_time_ever,
  panel_title("Panel A. PACE"),
  lines8(c("PACE_GRADE", "PACE_SCHOOL", "PACE_BOTH")),   # the paper's order: the grade rule first
  "\\midrule",
  panel_title("Panel B. BEA"),
  lines8("BEA_GRADE"),
  "\\midrule",
  n_lines(est8, TRUE),
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}"
)
write_tex(tex8, "pace_bea_access.tex")
cat(tex8, sep = "\n")

# the appendix's check: the students holding each seat (ever), and those of them meeting the matching row
walk(c("PACE_SEAT_EVER", "BEA_SEAT_EVER"), function(v) flag(sample3[[v]], v))
seat_holders <- tibble(seat = c("PACE", "BEA"), row = c("PACE_BOTH_EVER", "BEA_GRADE_EVER"),
                       holders = c(sum(sample3$PACE_SEAT_EVER == 1L), sum(sample3$BEA_SEAT_EVER == 1L)),
                       meeting = c(sum(sample3$PACE_SEAT_EVER == 1L & sample3$PACE_BOTH_EVER == 1L),
                                   sum(sample3$BEA_SEAT_EVER == 1L & sample3$BEA_GRADE_EVER == 1L)))
seat_holders
```

## The schools on the PACE list

The share of the over-demanded schools with a 12th grade on the Ministry's PACE list, by school year, against the other publicly funded
schools with a 12th grade (the text's footnote on PACE schools).

```{r pace-list-share}
flag(schools$OVER_DEMANDED, "OVER_DEMANDED (schools)"); flag(schools$ON_PACE_LIST, "ON_PACE_LIST")
stopifnot("the schools' two flags are logical (the shares below index by them)" = is.logical(schools$OVER_DEMANDED) && is.logical(schools$ON_PACE_LIST))
pace_share <- schools %>%
  group_by(YEAR, OVER_DEMANDED) %>%
  summarise(schools = n(), on_pace_list = sum(ON_PACE_LIST), share_pct = 100 * mean(ON_PACE_LIST), .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(nrow(pace_share) == 14L)   # 2019-2025, both groups
as.data.frame(mutate(pace_share, share_pct = round(share_pct, 1)))
round(range(pace_share$share_pct[pace_share$OVER_DEMANDED]), 1)    # the over-demanded schools
round(range(pace_share$share_pct[!pace_share$OVER_DEMANDED]), 1)   # the other publicly funded schools with a 12th grade
```

# Appendix Table D.1: the promotion rules in secondary education

The rules of the school years 2017-2025 that promote a student with one or two subjects below 4.0, and the attendance minimum: Decrees
112 (1999), 83 (2001) and 67 (2018) for regular secondary education, Decree 2169 (2007) for adult secondary education (constants; no
data). The paper's note to the table explains the marks a, b and c.

```{r promotion-rules}
promotion_rules <- tribble(
  ~program,                      ~rule,                             ~years,       ~one,               ~two,                 ~attendance,
  "Regular secondary education", "Grades 9--10, Decree 112 (1999)", "2017--2019", "4.5",              "5.0",                "85\\%",
  "Regular secondary education", "Grades 11--12, Decree 83 (2001)", "2017--2019", "4.5",              "5.0 or 5.5$^{a}$",   "85\\%",
  "Regular secondary education", "Grades 9--12, Decree 67 (2018)",  "2020--2025", "4.5",              "5.0",                "85\\%",
  "Adult secondary education",   "Decree 2169 (2007)$^{c}$",        "2017--2025", "4.5 or 5.0$^{b}$", "Special evaluation", "80\\% per subject"
)
promotion_lines <- unlist(map(unique(promotion_rules$program), function(p) {
  r <- filter(promotion_rules, program == .env$p)
  c(panel_title(p), map_chr(seq_len(nrow(r)), function(i) tex_row(paste0("\\quad ", r$rule[i]), c(r$years[i], r$one[i], r$two[i], r$attendance[i]))))
}))
tex_promotion <- c(
  "\\begin{tabular}{lcccc}",
  "\\toprule",
  " & & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{Minimum average with} & \\\\",
  " & School & \\multicolumn{2}{c}{subjects below 4.0} & Minimum \\\\",
  "\\cmidrule(lr){3-4}",
  "Grades and decree & years & One & Two & attendance \\\\",
  "\\midrule",
  promotion_lines,
  "\\bottomrule",
  "\\end{tabular}"
)
write_tex(tex_promotion, "appendix_promotion_rules.tex")
cat(tex_promotion, sep = "\n")
```

# Appendix Table D.3: PACE's academic rules by admission process

The rules of the six admission processes, from the official guides of 2021-2023, Resolution 3625 of June 29, 2023, and the 2025-2026
guides (constants; no data).

```{r pace-rules}
pace_rules <- tibble(
  admission_process = 2021:2026,
  graduation_cohort = 2020:2025,
  top_share = c(.15, .15, .20, .20, .25, .25),
  minimum_ranking = c(710, 749, 863, 851, 815, 830),
  valid_through = c(2021L, 2022L, 2024L, 2025L, 2026L, 2027L)
)
stopifnot(all(pace_rules$admission_process == pace_rules$graduation_cohort + 1L))
rules_rows <- pace_rules %>%
  mutate(valid = ifelse(valid_through == admission_process, as.character(admission_process), paste0(admission_process, "--", valid_through))) %>%
  with(paste0(admission_process, " & ", graduation_cohort, " & ", 100 * top_share, "\\% & $\\geq ", minimum_ranking, "$ & ", valid, " \\\\"))
tex_pace_rules <- c(
  "\\begin{table}[!htbp]",
  "\\singlespacing\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.25}\\centering",
  "\\caption{PACE Academic Requirements by Admission Process}\\label{tab: pace annual rules}",
  "\\small\\begin{tabular}{ccccc}\\toprule",
  "Admission & Graduation & Within-school & Absolute Ranking & Valid admission \\\\",
  "process & cohort & top share & alternative & processes \\\\\\midrule",
  rules_rows,
  "\\bottomrule\\end{tabular}\\par\\smallskip",
  "\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\footnotesize",
  paste0("Notes: Each row describes a newly graduating cohort. The academic condition is the within-school ",
    "percentile of the official Ranking score or the absolute-score alternative. Scores use the 150--850 ",
    "scale in 2021--2022 and the approximately 100--1000 scale from 2023. Students must also attend ",
    "grades 11 and 12 and graduate from a participating school, and take reading, mathematics ",
    "(Mathematics 1 from 2023), and an elective in history/social sciences or sciences. From 2023, ",
    "school history and the academic condition establish prehabilitation; the required regular exams ",
    "establish habilitation. A previous cohort can retain eligibility in the following process, ",
    "subject to exam completion and the one-use condition, without being reassessed under the new ",
    "cohort's academic threshold. The 2024--2026 rules count enrollment at a PACE university as use ",
    "regardless of the admission track. The 2024 resolution defines the percentile reference group ",
    "as graduates meeting the school-history condition. Selection ranks eligible applications using ",
    "80\\% Ranking and 20\\% NEM, with territorial and preference-order bonuses; the 2025--2026 ",
    "guides also include degree-type bonuses. Eligibility does not imply application or selection."),
  paste0("Sources: Annual official guides for 2021--2023 ",
    "\\citep{paceRules2021,paceRules2022,paceRules2023}, Resolution 3625 of June 29, 2023 ",
    "for admission 2024 \\citep{paceRules2024}, and the 2025--2026 guides ",
    "\\citep{paceRules2025,paceRules2026}."),
  "\\end{minipage}\\end{table}"
)
write_tex(tex_pace_rules, "appendix_pace_rules.tex")
cat(tex_pace_rules, sep = "\n")
```

# Every estimate at full precision

Written to `out_dir/numbers/mechanisms_estimates.csv` (17 significant digits), so that the tables can be checked against other runs. `table`
is the table file the row is printed in (`text` for numbers of the text and notes), `column` its panel or column. For each outcome of a table
(a row printed on time and ever is two outcomes): the estimate, its SE, p-value and N, the students without an offer among them (n0) and
their mean. Also: the distance's cap (km); the grade-stringency numbers of the text (its robustness estimates, whether the index is
observed on the offer, the calibration counts); and for the text, each year's share of schools on the PACE list (%) over the schools it is
computed on (n), the shares of Table IV's children with each admission score on time (%) over those children (n), the count of
students with official NEM and Ranking (est) among those with both ever (n), the share of the students of Panel D who fail 9th grade that
end it in the bottom fifth (%) over those who fail (n), and the students holding a PACE or a BEA seat ever (est) among Table IV's children
(n), with those of them meeting the matching row (est) among the holders (n). The numbers the text works out from two estimates of the
tables are rows too (est): the effects on class size and on students per teacher over their means without an offer (%); how much lower
the start of 9th grade is (the change's effect less the end-of-year effect, in percentile points); the declines in meeting PACE's grade
rule, BEA's grade rule and both PACE conditions on time over their means without an offer (%; BEA's also as a fraction); and BEA's fraction
times the BEA assignment rate on time without an offer (percentage points).

```{r estimates}
choice_vars <- paste0(list_rows$var[list_rows$panel == "A"], rep(c("_OT", "_EVER"), each = sum(list_rows$panel == "A")))
stringency_rows <- function(spec, var) {
  r <- stringency[specification == spec]
  stopifnot(nrow(r) == 1L)
  tibble(table = "grade_stringency_facts", column = "robustness", var = var, est = r$est, se = r$se, p = r$p, n = r$n, n0 = r$n_nooffer, mean = r$mean)
}
score_share <- function(v) tibble(table = "text", column = "share with the score, on time", var = v,
                                  est = 100 * est6$n[est6$var == v] / nrow(sample3), n = nrow(sample3))
# the value of field in the one row of d whose column `by` equals key; it stops on a miss, a duplicate or an NA key
one_value <- function(d, key, field, by = "var") {
  hit <- which(d[[by]] == key)
  if (length(key) != 1L || length(hit) != 1L) stop("one row with ", by, " = ", key, " expected, ", length(hit), " found")
  d[[field]][[hit]]
}
stopifnot("one_value self-test" = local({
  d <- tibble(var = c("a", "b", "b", NA), est = c(1, 2, 3, 4))
  fails <- function(...) inherits(tryCatch(one_value(d, ...), error = function(e) e), "error")
  identical(one_value(d, "a", "est"), 1) && fails("z", "est") && fails(NA, "est") && fails("b", "est") && fails(c("a", "a"), "est")
}))
# the numbers the text works out from two estimates, at full precision from the estimates above: the effect over the mean without an offer;
# the effect on the percentile at the start of 9th grade is the end-of-year effect less the change's (the same students), so the start is
# lower by the change's effect less the end-of-year effect; BEA's decline as a fraction, times the BEA assignment rate on time without an
# offer (Table VI's BEA row, in %)
over_mean <- function(est, v) one_value(est, v, "est") / one_value(est, v, "mean")
bea_fraction <- -over_mean(est8, "BEA_GRADE_OT")
decline <- "PACE and BEA, on time: decline over the mean without an offer (%)"
derived <- tibble(
  table = "text",
  column = c("Panel C: effect over the mean without an offer (%)", "Panel C: effect over the mean without an offer (%)",
             "Panel D: how much lower the start of 9th grade is (percentile points; the change's effect less the end-of-year effect)",
             decline, decline, "BEA, on time: decline over the mean without an offer (fraction)",
             "BEA, on time: the decline fraction times the BEA assignment rate without an offer (percentage points)", decline),
  var = c("CLASS_SIZE_EFFECT_OVER_MEAN", "STUDENT_TEACHER_EFFECT_OVER_MEAN", "START_PERCENTILE_LOWER", "PACE_GRADE_OT_DECLINE",
          "BEA_GRADE_OT_DECLINE", "BEA_GRADE_OT_DECLINE_FRACTION", "BEA_ASSIGNED_OT_IMPLIED_DECLINE", "PACE_BOTH_OT_DECLINE"),
  est = c(100 * over_mean(est5c, "CLASS_SIZE"), 100 * over_mean(est5c, "STUDENT_TEACHER"),
          one_value(est5d, "CHANGE", "est") - one_value(est5d, "RANK9", "est"),
          -100 * over_mean(est8, "PACE_GRADE_OT"), 100 * bea_fraction, bea_fraction, bea_fraction * 100 * one_value(est_t, "BEA_OT", "mean"),
          -100 * over_mean(est8, "PACE_BOTH_OT")))
as.data.frame(derived[c("var", "est")])
estimates <- bind_rows(
  mutate(est5, table = "lottery_graduation_part1", column = ifelse(var %in% grad, "graduation", ifelse(sub("_(OT|EVER)$", "", var) %in% names(reasons), "Panel A", "Panel B"))),
  mutate(est5c, table = "lottery_graduation_part2", column = "Panel C"),
  tibble(table = "lottery_graduation_part2", column = "Panel C", var = "GRADE_STRINGENCY", est = main$est, se = main$se, p = main$p, n = main$n,
         n0 = main$n_nooffer, mean = main$mean),
  tibble(table = "lottery_graduation_part2", column = "Panel C", var = "cap_km", est = cap),
  mutate(est5d, table = "lottery_graduation_part2", column = "Panel D"),
  stringency_rows("Unshrunk historical school effects", "GRADE_STRINGENCY_UNSHRUNK"),
  stringency_rows("Exclude historical cohort 2014", "STRINGENCY_EXCLUDING_2014"),
  stringency_rows("Exclude historical cohort 2015", "STRINGENCY_EXCLUDING_2015"),
  stringency_rows("Exclude historical cohort 2016", "STRINGENCY_EXCLUDING_2016"),
  stringency_rows("Common math-reading support calibration", "STRINGENCY_COMMON_SUPPORT"),
  tibble(table = "grade_stringency_facts", column = "availability", var = c("HAS_STRINGENCY", "HAS_STRINGENCY_NO_OFFER", "HAS_STRINGENCY_OFFER"),
         est = c(availability_result$offer_effect, lot[OFFER == 0, mean(HAS_STRINGENCY)], lot[OFFER == 1, mean(HAS_STRINGENCY)]),
         se = c(availability_result$se, NA, NA), p = c(availability_result$p, NA, NA),
         n = c(availability_result$n, sum(lot$OFFER == 0), sum(lot$OFFER == 1)), n0 = c(sum(lot$OFFER == 0), NA, NA),
         mean = c(availability_result$mean_nooffer, NA, NA)),
  tibble(table = "grade_stringency_facts", column = "calibration", var = c("students", "schools", "failed", "lottery_children"),
         est = c(nrow(d), uniqueN(d$RBD), sum(d$SIT_FIN_R == "R"), nrow(lot))),
  mutate(est_t, table = "lottery_admission_tracks", column = "2SLS"),
  mutate(filter(est7, var %in% choice_vars), table = "lottery_application_choices", column = "2SLS"),
  mutate(est6, table = "lottery_admission_scores", column = "Panel A"),
  mutate(filter(est7, sub("_(OT|EVER)$", "", var) %in% list_rows$var[list_rows$panel == "B"]), table = "lottery_admission_scores", column = "Panel B"),
  mutate(filter(est7, sub("_(OT|EVER)$", "", var) %in% list_rows$var[list_rows$panel == "C"]), table = "lottery_admission_scores",
         column = "Panel C (comment lines)"),
  mutate(est8, table = "pace_bea_access", column = ifelse(startsWith(var, "BEA"), "Panel B", "Panel A")),
  mutate(est_years, table = "appendix_failing_by_year", column = "Failed a year"),
  transmute(pace_share, table = "text", column = ifelse(OVER_DEMANDED, "PACE-list share, over-demanded schools", "PACE-list share, other schools"),
            var = as.character(YEAR), est = share_pct, n = schools),
  score_share("SCORE_LM_OT"),
  score_share("SCORE_NEM_OT"),
  tibble(table = "text", column = "official NEM and Ranking, ever", var = "SCORE_NEM_RANKING_EVER_OFFICIAL", est = n_official, n = n_both),
  tibble(table = "text", column = "Panel D: of those failing 9th grade, in the bottom fifth (%)", var = "BOTTOM20_AMONG_FAILED_9",
         est = bottom_among_failed$share_pct, n = bottom_among_failed$failed),
  tibble(table = "text", column = rep(c("PACE seat holders, ever", "BEA seat holders, ever"), each = 2L),
         var = c("PACE_SEAT_EVER", "PACE_SEAT_EVER_MEETING_BOTH", "BEA_SEAT_EVER", "BEA_SEAT_EVER_MEETING_GRADE"),
         est = c(one_value(seat_holders, "PACE", "holders", "seat"), one_value(seat_holders, "PACE", "meeting", "seat"),
                 one_value(seat_holders, "BEA", "holders", "seat"), one_value(seat_holders, "BEA", "meeting", "seat")),
         n = c(nrow(sample3), one_value(seat_holders, "PACE", "holders", "seat"), nrow(sample3), one_value(seat_holders, "BEA", "holders", "seat"))),
  derived
) %>%
  select(table, column, variable = var, est, se, p, n, n0, mean)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(select(estimates, table, column, variable)))
estimates %>%
  mutate(across(c(est, se, p, mean), function(x) sprintf("%.17g", x))) %>%
  write.csv(file.path(out_dir, "numbers", "mechanisms_estimates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
nrow(estimates)
```

# The numbers and statements of the mechanisms section's text and of its appendix

The numbers the mechanisms section and its appendix quote are written, named as the macro the text prints, to
`numbers/mechanisms_text_numbers.csv` and, as LaTeX macros, to `tables/mechanisms_text_macros.tex`. Effects are quoted in absolute value where
the text gives their direction in words, and a statement below checks each such direction; the withdrawal estimate, which the text quotes
with no direction, keeps its sign. Shares are plain numbers, and the text adds the percent sign. The
text's Table IV numbers are the outcomes notebook's macros, and its grade-stringency numbers are those of `grade_stringency_facts.tex`; the
years, the rules' constants and the appendix's three counts of 2025 graduates stay typed. Each statement the text makes about these results
is then checked and written, with whether it holds, to `numbers/mechanisms_text_claims.csv`, and the knit stops when one does not hold.

```{r text-numbers}
pp <- function(x) num(abs(100 * x), 2)                # an effect on a 0/1 row in percentage points (the direction in words)
pct <- function(x, d = 2) num(100 * x, d)             # a mean of a 0/1 row in %
est_of <- function(est, v) one_value(est, v, "est")   # an estimate at full precision
mean0 <- function(est, v) one_value(est, v, "mean")   # its mean without an offer
dv <- function(v) one_value(derived, v, "est")        # a number the text works out from two estimates
pace_range <- function(od) num(range(pace_share$share_pct[pace_share$OVER_DEMANDED == od]), 1)   # the lowest and highest yearly share (%)
seats <- function(seat, field) comma(one_value(seat_holders, seat, field, "seat"))
od_range <- pace_range(TRUE); other_range <- pace_range(FALSE)
text_numbers <- tribble(
  ~macro,                         ~value,                                          ~what,
  "MechDistanceCapKm",            num(cap, 0),                                     "Table V's note: the distance's cap, its 99th percentile among the students with every characteristic, km",
  "MechFailedYearOnTime",         pp(est_of(est5, "FAILNG_OT")),                   "Table V, failed a year and did not graduate, on time, pp",
  "MechFailedYearEver",           pp(est_of(est5, "FAILNG_EVER")),                 "Table V, failed a year and did not graduate, ever, pp",
  "MechFailedYearOnTimeMean",     pct(mean0(est5, "FAILNG_OT")),                   "Table V, failed a year, on time, mean without an offer, %",
  "MechFailedYearEverMean",       pct(mean0(est5, "FAILNG_EVER")),                 "Table V, failed a year, ever, mean without an offer, %",
  "MechWithdrewEver",             num(100 * est_of(est5, "WDNG_EVER"), 2),         "Table V, withdrew, ever, pp (with its sign: the text gives no direction)",

  "MechGradesEver",               pp(est_of(est5, "PB_G_EVER")),                   "Table V, failing on grades, ever, pp",

  "MechAttendanceUnknownEver",    pp(est_of(est5, "PB_U_EVER")),                   "Table V, failing on attendance with grades unknown, ever, pp",

  "MechFailedNinthMean",          pct(mean0(est5d, "FAILED_9")),                   "Table V, failed 9th grade, mean without an offer, %",
  "MechStartPercentileLower",     num(dv("START_PERCENTILE_LOWER"), 2),            "how much lower the percentile at the start of 9th grade is, percentile points",

  "MechBottomFifthMean",          pct(mean0(est5d, "BOTTOM20")),                   "Table V, bottom fifth, mean without an offer, %",
  "MechBottomFifthAmongFailed",   num(bottom_among_failed$share_pct, 1),           "of the students of Panel D who fail 9th grade, those who end it in the bottom fifth, %",

  "MechRankingPartOnTime",        num(abs(est_of(est7, "LIST_SCORE_RANKING_OT")), 3), "Table VIII, its Ranking part, on time, SD",
  "MechNEMPartOnTime",            num(abs(est_of(est7, "LIST_SCORE_NEM_OT")), 3),  "Table VIII, its NEM part, on time, SD",
  "MechExamsPartOnTime",          num(abs(est_of(est7, "LIST_SCORE_EXAMS_OT")), 3), "Table VIII, its exams part, on time, SD",
  "MechPACEGradeOnTime",          pp(est_of(est8, "PACE_GRADE_OT")),               "Table IX, met PACE's grade rule, on time, pp",
  "MechBEAGradeOnTime",           pp(est_of(est8, "BEA_GRADE_OT")),                "Table IX, met BEA's grade rule, on time, pp",
  "MechPACEGradeMean",            pct(mean0(est8, "PACE_GRADE_OT")),               "Table IX, PACE's grade rule, on time, mean without an offer, %",
  "MechBEAGradeMean",             pct(mean0(est8, "BEA_GRADE_OT")),                "Table IX, BEA's grade rule, on time, mean without an offer, %",
```
