```{r text-numbers}
stopifnot("each macro name is letters only and appears once" = all(grepl("^[A-Za-z]+$", text_numbers$macro)) && !anyDuplicated(text_numbers$macro),
          "every number the text quotes has a value (none missing, empty or infinite)" =
            !anyNA(text_numbers$value) && all(nzchar(text_numbers$value)) && no_missing(text_numbers$value))
write.csv(text_numbers, file.path(out_dir, "numbers", "mechanisms_text_numbers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write_tex(sprintf("\\newcommand{\\%s}{%s}", text_numbers$macro, text_numbers$value), "mechanisms_text_macros.tex")
as.data.frame(text_numbers)

# a statement the current text makes about these results, named by the part of the paper that makes it: each is evaluated (an error counts
# as not holding) and written with whether it holds (numbers/mechanisms_text_claims.csv); each that does not hold is printed (a sentence of
# the text that moves with these results), and once they are all written the knit stops on it
text_claims <- function(...) {
  labels <- ...names()
  stopifnot("every statement carries its label, each once" = ...length() > 0L && !is.null(labels) && all(nzchar(labels)) && !anyDuplicated(labels))
  holds <- logical(...length())
  for (i in seq_len(...length())) holds[i] <- isTRUE(tryCatch(...elt(i), error = function(e) {
    message("a statement of the current text could not be evaluated (", conditionMessage(e), "): ", labels[i]); NA }))
  for (s in labels[!holds]) message("a statement of the current text does not hold with these results: ", s)
  tibble(statement = labels, holds = holds)
}
local({   # self-test: a true, a false and an erroring statement are recorded as TRUE, FALSE, FALSE; an unlabelled statement stops
  stops <- function(expr) inherits(tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) e), "error")
  s <- suppressMessages(text_claims("t1" = TRUE, "t2" = FALSE, "t3" = stop("an error")))
  stopifnot("text_claims self-test" = identical(s$holds, c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)) && identical(s$statement, c("t1", "t2", "t3")) && stops(text_claims(TRUE)))
})

row_of <- function(est, v) { r <- est[est$var == v, ]; if (nrow(r) != 1L) stop(nrow(r), " rows match ", v); r }
rows_of <- function(est, ...) bind_rows(map(c(...), function(v) row_of(est, v)))
ot_ever <- function(k) paste0(k, c("_OT", "_EVER"))
falls <- function(r) nrow(r) > 0L && all(r$est < 0 & r$p < 0.1)   # negative and statistically significant
rises <- function(r) nrow(r) > 0L && all(r$est > 0 & r$p < 0.1)   # positive and statistically significant
null <- function(r) nrow(r) > 0L && all(r$p >= 0.1)               # not statistically significant
claims <- text_claims(
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table V's graduation row (Table IV's) and its footnote on Table VIII: attending lowers graduation on time and ever, both statistically significant (the footnote's on-time application effect is Table IV's, checked by the outcomes notebook)" =
    falls(rows_of(est5, ot_ever("GRAD"))),
  "the mechanisms section's and the Introduction's text on Table V, Panel A: the graduation loss comes from failing a year (the Introduction: the graduation decline is concentrated among students with grade-related failures), which rises on time and ever, both statistically significant, by at least the graduation loss at each horizon" =
    rises(rows_of(est5, ot_ever("FAILNG"))) && all(map_lgl(c("_OT", "_EVER"), function(h) est_of(est5, paste0("FAILNG", h)) >= abs(est_of(est5, paste0("GRAD", h))))),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table V, Panel A: the estimates for withdrawal and other non-graduates are smaller than failing a year's, at each horizon" =
    all(map_lgl(c("_OT", "_EVER"), function(h) all(abs(rows_of(est5, paste0(c("WDNG", "OTHNG"), h))$est) < abs(est_of(est5, paste0("FAILNG", h)))))),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table V, Panel A: of withdrawal and other, only the ever estimate for withdrawal is statistically significant, at the 10% level" =
    row_of(est5, "WDNG_EVER")$p < 0.1 && row_of(est5, "WDNG_EVER")$p >= 0.05 && null(rows_of(est5, "WDNG_OT", "OTHNG_OT", "OTHNG_EVER")),
  "the mechanisms section's and the Introduction's text on Table V, Panel B: most of the rise comes from grade-related failures (Grades rises on time and ever, statistically significant, and is more than half of failing a year at each horizon)" =
    rises(rows_of(est5, ot_ever("PB_G"))) && est_of(est5, "PB_G_OT") > 0.5 * est_of(est5, "FAILNG_OT") && est_of(est5, "PB_G_EVER") > 0.5 * est_of(est5, "FAILNG_EVER"),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table V, Panel B: failing on attendance with grades unknown rises on time and ever, both statistically significant" =
    rises(rows_of(est5, ot_ever("PB_U"))),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table V, Panel B: failing on attendance alone shows no statistically significant effect" = null(rows_of(est5, ot_ever("PB_A"))),
  "the mechanisms section's and the Introduction's text on Table V, Panel C: attending increases class size and students per teacher, both statistically significant" =
    rises(rows_of(est5c, "CLASS_SIZE", "STUDENT_TEACHER")),
  "the mechanisms section's, the abstract's, the Introduction's and the conclusion's text on Table V, Panel C: these schools grade more strictly (the abstract: a more demanding school environment; the grade-stringency row positive and statistically significant)" =
    main$est > 0 && main$p < 0.1,
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table V, Panel C: the effect on distance to school is negative and statistically significant only at the 10% level, while class size, students per teacher and grade stringency are statistically significant at the 5% level or below" =
    row_of(est5c, "DIST_P99")$est < 0 && row_of(est5c, "DIST_P99")$p < 0.1 && row_of(est5c, "DIST_P99")$p >= 0.05 &&
    all(rows_of(est5c, "CLASS_SIZE", "STUDENT_TEACHER")$p < 0.05) && main$p < 0.05,
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table V, Panel D: attending raises failing 9th grade, statistically significant" = rises(row_of(est5d, "FAILED_9")),
  "the mechanisms section's, the Introduction's and the conclusion's text on Table D.2: ninth grade, the first year, is the year in which most of the rise in failing occurs (the first year's effect is the largest of the four and more than half of the effect on failing in any of years 1 to 4)" =
    local({ y <- map_dbl(paste0("FAIL_YEAR_", 1:4), function(v) est_of(est_years, v)); which.max(y) == 1L && y[1] > 0.5 * est_of(est_years, "FAIL_YEAR_ANY") }),
  "the mechanisms section's, the Introduction's, the conclusion's and the abstract's text on Table V, Panel D: students start 9th grade lower in their school's ranking, fall further during the year and end it lower (the change and the end-of-year percentile fall, statistically significant)" =
    dv("START_PERCENTILE_LOWER") > 0 && falls(rows_of(est5d, "CHANGE", "RANK9")),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table V, Panel D: the share ending 9th grade in the bottom fifth rises, statistically significant, and most students who fail 9th grade end it there" =
    rises(row_of(est5d, "BOTTOM20")) && bottom_among_failed$share_pct > 50,
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table VI's total (Table IV's college seat): attending lowers assignment on time and ever, both statistically significant" =
    falls(rows_of(est_t, ot_ever("ASSIGNED"))),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table VI: on time, attending lowers assignment through regular admission, PACE and BEA, all three statistically significant" =
    falls(rows_of(est_t, "REG_OT", "PACE_OT", "BEA_OT")),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table VI: on time, regular admission and PACE fall by similar amounts (the larger less than one and a half times the smaller, and their difference not statistically significant) and BEA by a smaller amount" =
    local({ r <- abs(est_of(est_t, "REG_OT")); p <- abs(est_of(est_t, "PACE_OT")); b <- abs(est_of(est_t, "BEA_OT"))
            max(r, p) < 1.5 * min(r, p) && row_of(est_t_diff, "REG_MINUS_PACE_OT")$p >= 0.1 && b < min(r, p) }),
  "the mechanisms section's and the Introduction's text on Table VI: ever, the losses are concentrated in BEA and PACE (both fall, statistically significant, together by at least half of the total's fall), and the regular-admission and gender-quota estimates are not statistically significant" =
    falls(rows_of(est_t, "BEA_EVER", "PACE_EVER")) && null(rows_of(est_t, "REG_EVER", "GENERO_EVER")) &&
    abs(est_of(est_t, "BEA_EVER") + est_of(est_t, "PACE_EVER")) >= 0.5 * abs(est_of(est_t, "ASSIGNED_EVER")),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table VII: none of the estimates is statistically significant, on time or ever, and each is below 1% of its mean without an offer (students list programs with similar weights)" =
    local({ r <- rows_of(est7, choice_vars); null(r) && all(abs(r$est) < 0.01 * abs(r$mean)) }),
  "the mechanisms section's, the abstract's, the Introduction's and the conclusion's text on Table VIII: attending raises the Math-Verbal mean slightly and lowers NEM and Ranking considerably, on time and ever, all statistically significant (the Math-Verbal effect below a quarter of NEM's and of Ranking's at each horizon), each ever estimate within 0.01 SD and within 10% of its on-time estimate" =
    rises(rows_of(est6, ot_ever("SCORE_LM"))) && falls(rows_of(est6, c(ot_ever("SCORE_NEM"), ot_ever("SCORE_RANKING")))) &&
    all(map_lgl(c("_OT", "_EVER"), function(h) abs(est_of(est6, paste0("SCORE_LM", h))) <
                  0.25 * min(abs(est_of(est6, paste0("SCORE_NEM", h))), abs(est_of(est6, paste0("SCORE_RANKING", h)))))) &&
    all(map_lgl(names(admission), function(k) {
      ot <- est_of(est6, paste0("SCORE_", k, "_OT")); ev <- est_of(est6, paste0("SCORE_", k, "_EVER"))
      abs(ev - ot) < 0.01 && abs(ev - ot) < 0.1 * abs(ot) })),
  "the mechanisms section's and the abstract's text on Table VIII, Panel B: attending lowers the application score at the listed programs (the abstract's weaker position in selection), statistically significant at both horizons" =
    falls(rows_of(est7, ot_ever("LIST_SCORE"))),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table VIII, Panel B: the Ranking and NEM parts fall and the exams part rises, all statistically significant at both horizons" =
    falls(rows_of(est7, c(ot_ever("LIST_SCORE_RANKING"), ot_ever("LIST_SCORE_NEM")))) && rises(rows_of(est7, ot_ever("LIST_SCORE_EXAMS"))),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table VIII, Panel B: the losses from the grade-based parts are more than three times the gain from the exams, on time and ever" =
    all(map_lgl(c("_OT", "_EVER"), function(h)
      abs(est_of(est7, paste0("LIST_SCORE_NEM", h))) + abs(est_of(est7, paste0("LIST_SCORE_RANKING", h))) > 3 * est_of(est7, paste0("LIST_SCORE_EXAMS", h)))),
  "the mechanisms section's text on Table VIII, Panel B: the exams gain comes from higher reading and history or science parts, with no statistically significant effect on mathematics, at both horizons" =
    rises(rows_of(est7, c(ot_ever("LIST_SCORE_READING"), ot_ever("LIST_SCORE_HIST_SCIENCE")))) && null(rows_of(est7, ot_ever("LIST_SCORE_MATH"))),
  "the mechanisms section's, the abstract's, the Introduction's and the conclusion's text on Table IX: attending lowers the shares meeting PACE's and BEA's grade rules, statistically significant at both horizons" =
    falls(rows_of(est8, c(ot_ever("PACE_GRADE"), ot_ever("BEA_GRADE")))),
  "a footnote of the mechanisms section on Tables IX and VI: the BEA decline implied by the grade rule is close to the estimated BEA assignment effect on time (within 0.1 percentage points and within a third of the estimate)" =
    local({ gap <- abs(dv("BEA_ASSIGNED_OT_IMPLIED_DECLINE") - 100 * abs(est_of(est_t, "BEA_OT"))); gap < 0.1 && gap < 100 * abs(est_of(est_t, "BEA_OT")) / 3 }),
  "the mechanisms section's, the abstract's, the Introduction's and the conclusion's text on Table IX: attending lowers the shares graduating from a PACE school and meeting both PACE conditions, on time, statistically significant (the conclusion: college eligibility tied to the school students attend)" =
    falls(rows_of(est8, "PACE_SCHOOL_OT", "PACE_BOTH_OT")),
  "a footnote of the mechanisms section, and the abstract, the Introduction and the conclusion, on the PACE list: in each school year 2019-2025 under 10% of the over-demanded schools with a 12th grade are on it, the highest year's share below half of the lowest year's share of the other publicly funded schools" =
    local({ od <- pace_share$OVER_DEMANDED %in% TRUE
            identical(sort(unique(pace_share$YEAR)), 2019:2025) && max(pace_share$share_pct[od]) < 10 && max(pace_share$share_pct[od]) < 0.5 * min(pace_share$share_pct[!od]) }),
  "the mechanisms section's closing paragraph: on time, attending lowers access through regular admission, PACE and BEA; it lowers the application score, graduation from a PACE school and the shares meeting PACE's and BEA's grade rules" =
    falls(rows_of(est_t, "REG_OT", "PACE_OT", "BEA_OT")) && falls(row_of(est7, "LIST_SCORE_OT")) && falls(rows_of(est8, "PACE_SCHOOL_OT", "PACE_GRADE_OT", "BEA_GRADE_OT")),
  "the mechanisms appendix's text on Table D.2: attending raises failing a year in the first four school years, statistically significant, and most of it comes from the first year (the first year's effect more than half of the four years' and at most all of it)" =
    rises(row_of(est_years, "FAIL_YEAR_ANY")) && est_of(est_years, "FAIL_YEAR_1") > 0.5 * est_of(est_years, "FAIL_YEAR_ANY") &&
    est_of(est_years, "FAIL_YEAR_1") <= est_of(est_years, "FAIL_YEAR_ANY"),
  "the mechanisms appendix's text on grade stringency: the calibration uses tenth graders of 2014-2016, none of them in the lottery sample" =
    identical(sort(unique(d$AGNO)), 2014:2016) && length(intersect(d$MRUN, panel$MRUN)) == 0L,
  "the mechanisms appendix's text on grade stringency: an offer raises the index's availability" = availability_result$offer_effect > 0,
  "the mechanisms appendix's text on grade stringency: the leave-one-cohort-out estimates are on the same lottery sample as the baseline (each N the baseline's)" =
    local({ loo <- stringency[grepl("^Exclude historical", specification)]; nrow(loo) == 3L && all(loo$n == main$n) })
)
write.csv(claims, file.path(out_dir, "numbers", "mechanisms_text_claims.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message(sprintf("%d statements of the current text checked; %d do not hold with these results", nrow(claims), sum(!claims$holds)))
if (!all(claims$holds)) stop("statements of the current text that do not hold with these results: ", paste(claims$statement[!claims$holds], collapse = "; "))
as.data.frame(claims)
```

# The files written

Checks that this knit wrote every file listed here, and prints each with its bytes and MD5.

```{r outputs}
written <- c(file.path("tables", c("lottery_graduation_part1.tex", "lottery_graduation_part2.tex", "grade_stringency_facts.tex",
                                   "lottery_admission_tracks.tex", "lottery_application_choices.tex", "lottery_admission_scores.tex",
                                   "pace_bea_access.tex", "appendix_promotion_rules.tex", "appendix_failing_by_year.tex", "appendix_pace_rules.tex",
                                   "mechanisms_text_macros.tex")),
             file.path("tables", "results", c("lottery_admission_tracks.tex", "lottery_application_choices.tex", "lottery_admission_scores.tex")),
             file.path("numbers", c("mechanisms_estimates.csv", "mechanisms_text_numbers.csv", "mechanisms_text_claims.csv")))
full <- file.path(out_dir, written)
stopifnot("every output was written by this knit" = all(file.exists(full)) && all(file.mtime(full) >= KNIT_START))
others <- setdiff(list.files(out_dir, recursive = TRUE), written)
if (length(others)) message("the output folder also holds files this knit did not write: ", paste(others, collapse = ", "))
data.frame(file = written, bytes = file.size(full), md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(full)))
```
